headline: Vikram Solar Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process Update before NCLAT
sum: Vikram Solar Limited disclosed proceedings before the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) relating to its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The intimation indicates an ongoing appellate stage in the insolvency resolution.
detail: Vikram Solar, a renewable energy manufacturer, notified the NSE of developments in CIRP proceedings pending appellate adjudication before NCLAT. The intimation does not specify the grounds of appeal, the respondent creditor class, or the underlying NCLT order under challenge. The timing (June 2026) suggests the case has progressed through NCLT to appellate stage, indicating either a challenge to the resolution plan approval, the admission order, or an interim order. Given Vikram Solar's operational significance in the domestic solar manufacturing sector, appellate outcome could affect supply chain and working capital positions of dependent manufacturers and distributors.
